pr_title: fix: Fix panic using `scan_parquet().with_row_index()` with hive partitioning enabled
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19861

This error occurs in the merge operation for the case where hive columns are also present in the data file and a `with_row_index()` is requested.

issue_context.title: With Row index not working on scan_parquet with hive partitioned data
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

First of all we can produce a dataset for reproducing this issue (just some random data)
```python
import random
import string

import polars as pl


RANGE = 5000000
ECUS = ['ECU1', 'ECU2', 'ECU3', 'ECU4', 'ECU5']
APPLICATIONS = ['APP1', 'APP2', 'APP3', 'APP4', 'APP5']
CONTEXTS = ['CTX1', 'CTX2', 'CTX3', 'CTX4', 'CTX5']


if __name__ == '__main__':
    pl.Config.set_verbose(True)

    data = [
        [1731658040 + i for i in range(RANGE)],
        [ECUS[random.randint(0, 4)] for _ in range(RANGE)],
        [APPLICATIONS[random.randint(0, 4)] for _ in range(RANGE)],
        [CONTEXTS[random.randint(0, 4)] for _ in range(RANGE)],
        [random.random() for _ in range(RANGE)],
        [''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, k=256)) for _ in range(RANGE)]
    ]
    schema = [
        ('tstamp', pl.Int64),
        ('ecu_id', pl.String),
        ('application_id', pl.String),
        ('context_id', pl.String),
        ('value', pl.Float64),
        ('text', pl.String),
    ]
    lf = pl.LazyFrame(data, schema=schema)

    lf.collect().write_parquet('data', partition_by=['ecu_id', 'application_id'], compression='zstd', statistics=True, compression_level=20)
```

Now when I try to read this data with scan_parquet and row_index enabled the application crashes with a Rust panic:
```python
import polars as pl

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pl.Config.set_streaming_chunk_size(5000000)
    pl.Config.set_verbose(True)

    path = '/'.join(['.', 'data', '*', '*', '*.parquet'])
    lf_input = pl.scan_parquet(path, hive_partitioning=True, parallel="columns", row_index_name='index').tail()
    lf_input.collect()
```

### Issue description

When i remove the "row_index_name='index'" it is working fine.

### Expected behavior

Index row filled with index content.
